changelog:
personwise-customer-onboarding 2.1.9

- Clarified policy: Skill may handle other course requests only if the user explicitly asks to do so with this Skill.
- Explicitly documented that installing or updating the PersonWise CLI requires host/user approval; Skill will use only official/bundled CLI and services unless the user requests otherwise.
- Updated attribution block to reflect new version.
- Added `allowed-tools` and `permissions` metadata for Bash.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
summary: Give every new customer an askable digital-human onboarding course.
